text: Secure web development is essential to protect user data and maintain trust. First, every website should use HTTPS, which encrypts communication between the user’s browser and the server, preventing hackers from intercepting sensitive information. Secondly, strong authentication methods, such as two-factor authentication, help verify users’ identities and prevent unauthorized access. Additionally, input validation is critical—developers must check all data submitted through forms to avoid attacks like SQL injection or cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities also include outdated software and weak passwords. By addressing these issues, developers can create safer, more reliable websites.
